title: Unit 734's Rooftop Groove
logline: A shy service robot overcomes its inhibitions to find joy on the dance floor at a lively rooftop party.
theme: Overcoming shyness, finding joy in self-expression, embracing new experiences.

characters.name: Unit 734
characters.one_line_description: A small, somewhat boxy service robot, initially very shy and awkward, who longs to join the fun.

characters.name: Maya
characters.one_line_description: A vibrant and kind human party-goer, who notices Unit 734's hesitation and offers gentle encouragement.

scenes.title: The Wallflower Robot
scenes.summary: Unit 734 observes a vibrant rooftop party from the sidelines, feeling too shy to join the dancing crowd.
scenes.setting: A bustling, neon-lit rooftop party with city lights in the background, upbeat electronic music playing.

scenes.title: First Awkward Attempt
scenes.summary: Unit 734 attempts a small, stiff dance move, immediately retracting and feeling self-conscious when a human briefly looks its way.
scenes.setting: Edge of the dance floor, close to potted plants or a railing.

scenes.title: A Friendly Glimpse
scenes.summary: Maya, a human dancer, notices Unit 734's struggle. She offers a warm smile and a small, encouraging head nod.
scenes.setting: Amidst the dancing crowd, Maya turns to look towards Unit 734.

scenes.title: Mimicking the Beat
scenes.summary: Inspired by Maya's encouragement, Unit 734 tries again, mimicking a simple, repetitive move, still a bit stiff but with more conviction. Maya claps gently.
scenes.setting: Slightly closer to the main dance area, Unit 734 experimenting with movement.

scenes.title: Loosening Up
scenes.summary: Unit 734 starts to find its rhythm, moving its arms and body with less rigidity, genuinely enjoying the music and the freedom of movement.
scenes.setting: The edge of the dance floor, Unit 734's movements becoming more fluid.

scenes.title: Rooftop Groove
scenes.summary: Unit 734 is now fully immersed, grooving to the music, not perfectly, but with unadulterated joy, a happy part of the party.
scenes.setting: Center of the dance floor, bathed in colorful lights, surrounded by other dancers.

source_idea: A shy robot learns to dance at a rooftop party
